briefdescription.para: Shared GPIO interrupt handler for configured MIO pins.

detaileddescription.para: Called by the GIC dispatcher when a PS-GPIO or PMC-GPIO interrupt fires (GICP0 SRC20 for LPD GPIO, or GICP6 SRC10 for PMC GPIO).

The handler iterates every entry in GpioProcCfg[] and, for each pin whose INT_STAT bit is set, checks the DATA_RO level. A rising edge (INT_STAT pending + DATA_RO high) triggers XPlmi_ExecuteProc() with that pin's ProcId. This allows multiple MIO pins on the same GPIO controller to share one GIC source while each executing a different CDO proc.
After processing all pins the handler clears INT_STAT, re-enables the GPIO INT_EN / INT_ANY bits, and re-enables the GIC source so subsequent toggles are delivered.

parameterdescription.para: Unused (handler iterates the global GpioProcCfg array).

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS always (errors are logged but do not propagate).

briefdescription.para: Read the current state of a device or power node.

detaileddescription.para: Dispatches the query according to the class encoded in DeviceId. Device nodes are handled by XPmDevice_GetState(), while power nodes are handled by XPmPower_GetState(). On success, the selected handler writes the current node state to DeviceState.

parameterdescription.para: Device or power node ID to query.

Pointer that receives the current state: CPU nodes use 0 for powered down, 1 for active, and 8 for suspending; power islands and domains use 0 for powered down and 2 for powered up; slave devices use 0 for powered down, 1 for powered up, and 9 for retention. It is not modified by this function when the node class is unsupported.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when the state was obtained; XST_INVALID_PARAM when the node class is neither device nor power; otherwise an error returned by the selected state query.

briefdescription.para: Request Device from PMC Subsystem (weak boot stub).

detaileddescription.para: : Device node ID to request

Sets the PmcAllocated flag on the device so that the device FSM's GetMaxCapabilities() accounts for PMC's usage. This prevents premature device shutdown when a device is shared between PMC and another subsystem (e.g. APU requests then releases the same device).

In boot-only mode this is sufficient: CDO has already configured clocks and resets, so only the power domain needs tracking via BringUp. The runtime strong override adds FSM-aware bring-up (power + clocks + resets) for devices re-requested after release.
Return: XST_SUCCESS on successful request, error code on failure.

briefdescription.para: Register one RTCA GPIO-to-procedure configuration.

detaileddescription.para: Decodes a 16-bit configuration containing the SLR, GPIO controller, bank, one-based MIO index, and procedure ID. The function rejects unsupported values and duplicate pins, caches the decoded entry in GpioProcCfg[], and registers the shared GPIO handler when the selected GIC source does not already have one. On success it enables the GIC source and the pin's GPIO interrupt and any-edge detection bits.

parameterdescription.para: Configuration value from either half of an RTCA GPIO procedure configuration register, shifted into bits [15:0].

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when the pin was registered and enabled; XST_INVALID_PARAM for an invalid MIO index, bank, controller, or duplicate pin; XST_FAILURE when the registration table is full; otherwise an error from XPm_GetDeviceBaseAddr() or XPlmi_GicRegisterHandler().

briefdescription.para: Initialize GPIO-triggered CDO procedure handlers from RTCA settings.

detaileddescription.para: Reads all four RTCA GPIO procedure configuration registers and passes each nonzero 16-bit half to XPm_GpioRegisterPin(). After both halves of a register are accepted, clears that register so the configuration is not processed again. Empty registers are left unchanged. Processing stops on the first registration failure, leaving that register uncleared.
Each half encodes the SLR in bits [2:0], controller in [4:3], bank in [6:5], one-based MIO index in [12:7], and CDO procedure ID in [15:13].

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when every nonzero configuration was registered; otherwise the first error returned by XPm_GpioRegisterPin().
